title: "10. 底格里斯河畔亚历山大城的确认与城市景观"
subtitle: "Alexandria on the Tigris and its urban landscape"
---

::: {.discovery-meta}

Southern Iraq / 伊拉克南部

**Date / 年代**  
Hellenistic–Parthian era · ca. 300 BCE–300 CE / 希腊化—帕提亚时期

University of Konstanz; Charax Spasinou Project; British archaeological and geophysical collaborators working in southern Iraq

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 自2016年以来的大规模地表调查、无人机与磁力勘探系统揭示这座早在1960年代已由航片定位的网格化大型港口城市，包括街道、住宅区、神庙、作坊、运河、港湾及农业腹地。

**English.** Since 2016, large-scale surface survey, drone mapping, and magnetometry have systematically revealed the layout of a major gridded port city whose location had already been proposed from aerial photographs in the 1960s with streets, residential blocks, temples, workshops, canals, harbor basins, and an agricultural hinterland.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 2026年成果的价值不在于“首次确认地点”，而在于首次系统揭示城市布局、功能分区与基础设施。该项目把古代远距离贸易从“发现外来商品”推进到研究维系贸易的城市基础设施。它连接印度洋海运、波斯湾、底格里斯河运与美索不达米亚腹地，也把城市兴衰与河道迁移、海岸线变化放在同一分析框架。

**English.** The project moves the archaeology of long-distance exchange beyond imported goods toward the infrastructure that sustained exchange. It connects Indian Ocean shipping, the Persian Gulf, Tigris river transport, and the Mesopotamian interior while linking urban fortunes to river migration and shoreline change.
